name: Jaime Wu
bio:
Jaime is a Undergraduate Student at the University Of Auckland studying a conjoint degree in Engineering Science, Finance, and Economics. With a keen interest in learning and exploring the likes of data science and machine learning, Jaime's Part IV Engineering project involved the improvement of unsupervised question-answer using state of the art BERT-like language models and synthetic data.

Aside from his technical interests, Jaime also enjoys power-lifting and investing.
